gloss: to harbor; to carry (a child); to reflect (light)

definitions.gloss: to harbor, to hold within, to carry
definitions.explanation: To contain or hold something intangible within oneself — an emotion, a thought, a spirit, or a quality.
To become pregnant, to carry a child in one's womb. A literary or formal expression.
For a surface to hold or reflect light, moisture, or color. A poetic expression.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{目|め}には{強|つよ}い{意志|いし}が{宿|やど}っていた。
examples.english: A strong will dwelled in his eyes.

examples.japanese: この{作品|さくひん}には{作者|さくしゃ}の{魂|たましい}が{宿|やど}っている。
examples.english: The soul of the creator dwells in this work.

examples.japanese: {言葉|ことば}に{力|ちから}を{宿|やど}す。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{新|あたら}しい{命|いのち}を{宿|やど}していた。
examples.english: She was carrying a new life within her.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}つゆの{宿|やど}った{花|はな}が{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The flowers with morning dew on them are beautiful.

examples.japanese: {涙|なみだ}を{宿|やど}した{瞳|ひとみ}で{見|み}つめた。
{葉|は}の{上|うえ}に{光|ひかり}を{宿|やど}した{雨粒|あまつぶ}が{輝|かがや}いていた。
examples.english: Raindrops catching the light on the leaves were sparkling.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}), す-ending.
- Negative: {宿|やど}さない
- Polite: {宿|やど}します
- Te-form: {宿|やど}して
- Past: {宿|やど}した

USAGE:
{宿|やど}す has a literary, elevated tone across all senses. The intransitive form {宿|やど}る (to dwell in, to be present within) is also common and appears in similar contexts. The transitive {宿|やど}す emphasizes the subject actively harboring or imbuing something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {命|いのち}を{宿|やど}す: to carry a life
- {子|こ}を{宿|やど}す: to conceive a child
- {力|ちから}を{宿|やど}す: to imbue with power
- {魂|たましい}が{宿|やど}る: a soul dwells (intransitive form)
- {涙|なみだ}を{宿|やど}す: to hold tears
